title: The mailbox, a parcel
logline: The mailbox with its door open and a small parcel in it, brown paper, no return address the page will draw. Not Christmas yet. The page leaves it in the box.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox with its door open and a small brown-paper parcel inside, rain, the road empty, the flag down.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox with its door open and a small brown-paper parcel inside, rain and an empty road, the flag down, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
